name: sanity-template-nextjs-clean
description: Next.js + Sanity: A Powerful Website Starter with Real-time Visual Editing

scripts.import-sample-data: cd studio && sanity dataset import sample-data.tar.gz --dataset production --replace

_overridesComment: Sanity 6 resolved the prismjs and adm-zip advisories. These three remain because @vercel/frameworks and typeid-js pin vulnerable versions exactly, with no fixed release upstream. Ranges are used so future patch releases still apply. js-yaml is the exception: with a range npm dedupes it to eslint's hoisted 4.x, which is not vulnerable but drops the 3.x API (safeLoad) that @vercel/frameworks calls, so it must stay pinned to a 3.x version. Re-check on each sanity upgrade and delete any that upstream has fixed.
